title: Florsheim Shoe Shop Store Matchbook Matches Vintage Paramount Bootery Full
descriptionText: This is a vintage matchbook advertising Florsheim Shoe Shop Store at Paramount Bootery. The matchbook was made in the United States and is a collectible item featuring Florsheim Shoes.
